*Now how does Ogtha exist? Many moons ago, in the 9th grade, you and your class read Metamorphosis by Franz Kafka. The transformation of the main character into a roach shifted something inside you. In the deep recesses of your mind, you conjured up fantasies of taking care of the roach person in the story.. instead it was a woman. You were fantasizing about a giant roach woman.
